description: Systematically scan the environment to find the target entity and align the crosshair for engagement.
preconditions: The agent is in the vicinity of the target but does not have a clear line of sight or focus.
sub_tasks: Rotate the camera horizontally to scan the immediate area
Identify the target entity among environmental clutter
Adjust pitch and yaw to center the target in the crosshair

description: Close the distance to the target and deliver continuous strikes until the entity is defeated.
preconditions: The target is identified and the agent has a melee weapon equipped.
sub_tasks: Move forward to enter the entity's hit range
Execute rapid attack actions while tracking target movement
Adjust camera pitch to account for target height changes

description: Navigate to the entity's death location to collect experience orbs and item drops.
preconditions: The target entity has been successfully killed and items are visible on the ground.
sub_tasks: Look down toward the ground where the entity died
Walk directly over the dropped items
Pause briefly to ensure the pickup logic registers

description: Avoid spamming the attack action when the target is too far away or not centered in the crosshair.
preconditions: The agent is in combat but the target is moving rapidly or keeping distance.
common_mistakes: Spamming attack while the target is out of reach
Attacking the ground or air due to poor camera alignment
corrective_actions: Cease attacking and use forward movement to close the gap
Re-center the crosshair on the target before resuming strikes

description: Avoid long periods of inactivity (no-ops) during an active engagement which allows targets to move away.
preconditions: The agent has initiated combat but the target is still alive.
common_mistakes: Standing still for multiple frames after a target moves
Failing to input movement or camera actions during the orient phase
corrective_actions: Maintain constant camera micro-adjustments to track the mob
Use short forward bursts to stay within the strike zone

description: Navigate to the target block and center the crosshair to ensure mining actions register correctly.
preconditions: The target block must be visible in the immediate environment.
sub_tasks: Move toward the block until it is within reach distance
Adjust pitch and yaw to center the crosshair on the block face
Maintain a stable position to prevent the crosshair from drifting

description: Hold the attack action continuously until the block breaks and drops as a collectible item.
preconditions: The agent must be standing within three blocks of the target with the crosshair aligned.
sub_tasks: Hold the attack button without interruption
Wait for the block destruction animation to complete
Confirm the block has disappeared from the world

description: Equip the most effective tool for the specific block material to maximize mining speed.
preconditions: Appropriate tools like pickaxes or shovels are present in the hotbar.
sub_tasks: Identify if the block is stone, dirt, or wood-based
Select the corresponding hotbar slot for the required tool
Initiate mining with the active tool

description: Avoid moving away or looking at new targets before the current block is fully broken and its drops are collected.
preconditions: The agent has started mining a block but the item has not yet entered the inventory.
common_mistakes: Turning the camera away before the block breaks
Walking past the dropped item without picking it up
corrective_actions: Keep the crosshair on the block until the reward is triggered
Step directly onto the block's previous coordinates to collect drops

description: Use coordinated camera movements to locate and align the crosshair with the target before engaging.
preconditions: The target is visible or its general direction is known.
sub_tasks: Scan the environment using horizontal turns to locate the target.
Adjust vertical pitch to account for target height or terrain elevation.
Halt rotation once the target is centered in the crosshair.

description: Close the distance and deliver timed strikes to maximize hit probability and minimize counter-attacks.
preconditions: The target is centered and within visual range.
sub_tasks: Move forward to reach striking distance of the entity or block.
Trigger the attack action repeatedly while maintaining focus.
Adjust orientation during the attack to track moving targets.

description: Navigate to the location of a defeated entity or broken block to secure dropped items.
preconditions: The target has been successfully killed or mined and items have dropped.
sub_tasks: Identify the item entity on the ground.
Move directly over the item to trigger pickup.
Briefly pause to ensure the inventory update is processed.

description: Minimize unnecessary no-op actions and stationary periods to improve task efficiency.
preconditions: An active task is assigned and the target is reachable.
common_mistakes: Executing long sequences of no_op actions while the target is in view.
Standing still for multiple frames after completing an orientation turn.
corrective_actions: Initiate forward movement immediately upon centering the target.
Combine turning actions with forward movement to maintain momentum.
